[[000016]] PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION
[[000017]] A clear account of how RentalHub collects, uses, shares, stores and protects personal data across our website, mobile applications and services.
[[000018]] Effective 
[[000019]] The short version
[[000020]] RentalHub uses personal data to provide property, payment, communication, verification, support and related services. We share it as described below, including with service providers and people involved in a transaction or case.
[[000021]] Our privacy commitments
[[000022]] The principles behind every section of this notice.
[[000023]] 1. Who controls your data
[[000024]] Amana RentalHub NG ("RentalHub", "we", "us" or "our"), operating in Nigeria, is responsible for the personal data processed through rentalhub.com.ng, the Mobile Applications and connected RentalHub services, unless a separate notice says otherwise.
[[000025]] This policy applies to visitors, account holders, tenants, landlords, agents, lawyers, administrators, service providers, candidates and other people who use or interact with RentalHub.
[[000026]] 2. How we obtain personal data
[[000027]] We receive data from several sources, not only from forms.
[[000028]] Directly from you when you register, verify, list, apply, book, pay, message, upload, contact support or change settings.
[[000029]] From other RentalHub users and authorised roles involved in a listing, application, service, dispute, payment or legal workflow.
[[000030]] Automatically from your browser, device and app use, including security logs, diagnostics, cookies, analytics and notification tokens.
[[000031]] From providers that verify identity, process payments, deliver communications, host media or provide mapping and infrastructure.
[[000032]] 3. Data we collect and why
[[000033]] Each card explains the category, purpose, main lawful basis and retention approach.
[[000034]] 4. Sensitive data, identity and biometrics
[[000035]] Identity numbers, identity documents, live face images and some health or safety notes require greater care. We process them only for the relevant verification, safety, service, fraud-prevention or legal purpose and restrict access according to role and workflow.
[[000036]] RentalHub encrypts NIN values and keeps a separate protected hash to detect duplicate use without relying on the readable number.
[[000037]] Fingerprint or Face ID templates used to unlock a saved mobile session remain under the device operating system's control and are not sent to RentalHub.

[[000016]] SIRRI & KARE DATA
[000017]] Bayyanar bayanan yadda RentalHub ke tattarawa, amfani, rabawa, adanawa da kare bayanan sirri a cikin gidan yanar gizon mu, aikace-aikacen hannu da sabis.
[[000018]] Mai tasiri 
[[000019]] Gajeren sigar
[000020]] RentalHub yana amfani da bayanan sirri don samar da dukiya, biyan kuɗi, sadarwa, tabbatarwa, tallafi da ayyuka masu alaƙa. Muna raba shi kamar yadda aka bayyana a ƙasa, gami da masu ba da sabis da mutanen da ke da hannu a cikin wani ma'amala ko harka.
[000021]] Alkawuran sirrinmu
[000022]] Ka'idodin da ke bayan kowane sashe na wannan sanarwa.
[[000023]] 1. Wanda ke sarrafa bayanan ku
[[000024]] Amana RentalHub NG ("RentalHub", "mu", "mu" ko "namu"), da ke aiki a Najeriya, ita ce ke da alhakin bayanan sirri da aka sarrafa ta rentalhub.com.ng, Mobile Applications da kuma haɗin sabis na RentalHub, sai dai in wata sanarwa ta daban ta ce akasin haka.
[[000025]] Wannan manufar ta shafi baƙi, masu riƙe da asusu, masu haya, masu gida, wakilai, lauyoyi, masu gudanarwa, masu ba da sabis, ƴan takara da sauran mutanen da suke amfani ko mu'amala da RentalHub.
[[000026]] 2. Yadda muke samun bayanan sirri
[000027]] Muna karɓar bayanai daga tushe da yawa, ba kawai daga fom ba.
[000028]] Kai tsaye daga gare ku lokacin da kuka yi rajista, tabbatarwa, jera, nema, littafi, biya, saƙo, loda, tallafin tuntuɓar ko canza saitunan.
[000029]] Daga wasu masu amfani da RentalHub da izini masu izini da ke cikin jeri, aikace-aikace, sabis, jayayya, biyan kuɗi ko aikin doka.
[000030]] Ta atomatik daga burauzar ku, na'urar da amfani da app, gami da rajistan ayyukan tsaro, bincike, kukis, nazari da alamun sanarwa.
[000031]] Daga masu samarwa waɗanda ke tabbatar da ainihi, aiwatar da biyan kuɗi, sadar da sadarwa, watsa shirye-shiryen watsa labarai ko samar da taswira da abubuwan more rayuwa.
[[000032]] 3. Bayanan da muke tattarawa da kuma dalilin da ya sa
[000033]] Kowane kati yana bayyana nau'in, manufa, babban tushen halal da tsarin riƙewa.
[000034]] 4. Bayanai masu ma'ana, ainihi da ƙididdigar halittu
[000035]] Lambobin shaida, takaddun shaida, hotunan fuskar kai tsaye da wasu bayanan lafiya ko aminci suna buƙatar kulawa sosai. Muna sarrafa su kawai don tabbatarwa mai dacewa, aminci, sabis, rigakafin zamba ko manufar doka kuma muna ƙuntata samun dama bisa ga rawar da gudanawar aiki.
[000036 ]
[000037]] Samfurin sawun yatsa ko Face ID da aka yi amfani da su don buɗe zaman wayar hannu da aka ajiye sun kasance ƙarƙashin ikon tsarin aikin na'urar kuma ba a aika su zuwa RentalHub.
